question.text: Cross-currency futures contracts have which contract cycle?

answer.text: 12 serial monthly trading cycle only (no weekly contracts)

explanation.text: The Logic: Cross-currency futures have a 12 serial monthly trading cycle. INR-based currency futures, by contrast, offer both weekly and monthly cycles. The Trap: Weekly contracts are available only for INR-based currency pairs, not for cross-currency futures. Note: When comparing cycles, focus on the source-backed cycle structure (12 serial monthly vs INR weekly+monthly) — do not infer reasons from trading-activity assumptions.
